name: limit-alerts
description: Warns before a Claude subscription usage limit runs out: hook messages, macOS notifications, a limits-aware statusline and a /compact advisor.

lang.title: Notification language
lang.description: ru or en. Applies to hook messages, macOS banners and the statusline.

warn.title: Warning threshold
warn.description: Percent of a limit at which the first warning is sent.

crit.title: Critical threshold
crit.description: Percent of a limit at which the critical warning is sent.

attention.title: "Needs your attention" notifications
attention.description: macOS banner and sound when Claude waits for an answer or finishes a turn.

compact_advisor.title: /compact advisor
compact_advisor.description: Suggests running /compact at a logical breakpoint when the context window fills up.

compact_warn.title: /compact advisor threshold
compact_warn.description: Percent of the context window at which the /compact advisor speaks up; also where ctx turns yellow in the statusline.

forecast.title: Run-out forecast
forecast.description: Notifies once per window when, at the current pace, a limit runs out before it resets.

spend_alert.title: Paid credits alerts
spend_alert.description: Notifies when paid usage credits start being spent, and at the warning and critical percent of the spending limit.

unused_alert.title: Unused weekly limit reminder
unused_alert.description: Once a week, in the last day before a weekly limit resets, notifies when at the current pace a good part of it would go unused.

statusline_pace.title: Weekly pace in the statusline
statusline_pace.description: Shows ▲N when a weekly window runs ahead of an even pace (it runs out early) and ▼N when it lags behind (part of it resets unused).

guard_fanout.title: Ask before subagents near the weekly limit
guard_fanout.description: Once a weekly limit reaches the critical threshold, starting a subagent asks for confirmation first. Off by default.

model_hint.title: Suggest another model at a model-scoped limit
model_hint.description: Adds "carry on with another model (/model)" to the critical warning of a model-scoped weekly limit. Off by default.

statusline_model.title: Model segment in the statusline
statusline_model.description: Session model, effort, context fill and running subagents next to the limits.

subagent_model.title: Subagent model in the statusline
subagent_model.description: The model of a running subagent when it differs from the session's.

statusline.title: Limits in the statusline
statusline.description: Writes statusLine into ~/.claude/settings.json, preserving any existing statusline. Off by default because it edits a file outside the plugin.

launchd.title: Background agent (launchd)
launchd.description: Checks limits in the background (every 92 seconds by default, see interval) so notifications arrive while Claude Code is closed. Off by default because it registers a system agent.

interval.title: Background check interval
interval.description: Seconds between background checks of the launchd agent. Lower means faster notifications and more requests to the usage endpoint.
